rows.definition: The enforce-mode switch for the cadence report: under =enforce an INCOMPLETE report whose next action is a runnable rerun routes to the FLEET (decenter-the-human) instead of paging the operator; unset/false is byte-for-byte the un-triaged CheckGate (trendreport.AdvisoryGateTriaged).
rows.distinction: Flips ONLY the cadence report page-vs-act fold - NOT a runtime guard gate that admits/refuses a tool call, and NOT the sibling *_TRIAGE_GATE knobs that flip a DIFFERENT report.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardAutoRefreshEnabled: toggle (default ON) for whether the guard proactively drives the agent to rotate its own expiring credential so a headless seat self-heals without a human; falsey (0/false/off/no) restores the pure wait-for-rotation poll.
rows.distinction: The ON/OFF toggle for proactive refresh - NOT FAK_GUARD_AUTO_REFRESH_TIMEOUT (how long one refresh spawn may run) and NOT FAK_GUARD_REFRESH_SKEW (how early before expiry to fire).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardAutoRefreshTimeout: bounds a single active-refresh spawn (default = the 30s headless-rehydrate window) so a refresh turn that never returns cannot outlast the wait it replaces; any Go duration, clamped to a floor/ceiling.
rows.distinction: The per-spawn DURATION cap - NOT FAK_GUARD_AUTO_REFRESH (the on/off toggle) and NOT FAK_GUARD_REFRESH_SKEW (the pre-expiry lead time).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardRefreshSkew: how early before actual credential expiry a proactive refresh may fire (default 5m, clamped to 1h; 0 restores strict only-refresh-once-expired).
rows.distinction: The PRE-EXPIRY lead time - NOT FAK_GUARD_AUTO_REFRESH_TIMEOUT (the spawn duration cap) and NOT FAK_GUARD_AUTH_RECOVER_WINDOW (the post-crash recovery window).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go: the window within which a correlated auth crash is treated as recoverable (the guard waits/relogs rather than declaring a hard failure).
rows.distinction: The AUTH-CRASH recovery window - NOT FAK_GUARD_REFRESH_SKEW (a pre-expiry lead) and NOT the auto-refresh toggle; it governs crash handling, not proactive rotation.

rows.definition: internal/adjudicator/outoftree.go: an OS-path-list of absolute scratchpad roots the guard treats as sanctioned writable/out-of-tree locations, so writes there are not flagged as out-of-tree escapes.
rows.distinction: Declares SANCTIONED-WRITE roots for the out-of-tree adjudicator - NOT a credential-refresh knob and NOT FAK_GATE_MIN_WORKERS; it widens allowed write paths, not timing or worker floors.

rows.definition: internal/dispatchtick/preflight_gate.go: the operator floor overlaid on the preflight worker-cap gate - the minimum worker presence kept alive so a pressured fleet never drops to a 0 cap and stalls, while still refusing to GROW onto a slow kernel.
rows.distinction: A minimum-WORKERS floor on the dispatch preflight gate - NOT a triage-gate report switch and NOT FAK_GUARD_SCRATCHPAD_ROOTS; it governs fleet worker admission, not reports or paths.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard.go: env that OVERRIDES the --expose-profile flag selecting the in-kernel fak_* MCP tool-surface profile; the fleet opt-out (full/off) restores the whole registry instead of the curated headless allowlist a dispatch worker gets.
rows.distinction: Selects the MCP TOOL-SURFACE profile (registry breadth) - NOT FAK_GATE_MIN_WORKERS (a worker floor) and NOT a triage-gate report switch; it prunes/restores schema surface, not workers or reports.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_park.go guardParkForRelogin: parks a headless guard run when the credential is missing/expired, polling for the operator (or auto-refresh) to restore login within a budget, then reports whether it recovered.
rows.distinction: The PARK-and-wait-for-login loop - NOT guardClassifyAuthCrash (which decides IF a crash was auth-correlated) and NOT guardRunHeadlessRehydrate (the proactive pre-expiry rehydrate).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_park.go: the guard credential-PARK mechanism (budget + poll) that holds a headless seat idle while a missing/expired login is restored, rather than failing the run.
rows.distinction: The PARK subsystem (hold-and-wait for login) - NOT guardParkPoll (its poll-interval knob) and NOT the auto-refresh path that avoids parking by rotating early.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_park.go guardParkPoll: the poll interval at which a parked guard run re-checks whether the credential has been restored.
rows.distinction: The park POLL INTERVAL - NOT guardParkForRelogin (the park loop itself) and NOT guardParkBudget (the total park deadline).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardClassifyAuthCrash: decides whether a child crash was correlated with a missing/expired credential and whether it was recovered, from the credential state and a CredCheck.
rows.distinction: CLASSIFIES a crash as auth-related or not - NOT guardParkForRelogin (which then waits out an auth crash) and NOT guardRestartLimitStatus (restart-budget accounting).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardRunHeadlessRehydrate: runs the #1834 proactive rehydrate for a headless seat - refreshing an about-to-expire credential before it blocks, returning a verdict.
rows.distinction: The PROACTIVE pre-expiry rehydrate - NOT guardParkForRelogin (the reactive park after expiry) and NOT guardClassifyAuthCrash (post-crash classification).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_support.go guardEffectivePolicyDigest: hashes the EFFECTIVE guard policy - the base policy bytes unioned with the allow overlay and minus the deny overlay - into a digest identifying exactly what the guard is enforcing.
rows.distinction: A digest of the MERGED effective policy (base+allow-deny) - NOT loadGuardCapabilityFloor (which loads the base floor) and NOT protectGuardPolicyConfig (which write-protects the config).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_startup.go loadGuardCapabilityFloor: loads the base guard capability floor from a policy path, returning the policy runtime, the floor source, its digest, and load duration.
rows.distinction: LOADS the base capability floor - NOT guardEffectivePolicyDigest (the merged-policy hash after overlays) and NOT protectGuardPolicyConfig (write-protection).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_startup.go protectGuardPolicyConfig: marks the guard policy config paths as protected in the policy runtime, so a wrapped agent cannot edit the very files that constrain it.
rows.distinction: WRITE-PROTECTS the policy files - NOT loadGuardCapabilityFloor (which reads them) and NOT guardEffectivePolicyDigest (which hashes the result).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/dispatch_tick_worker.go guardedDispatchCommand: wraps a dispatch worker's command for a lane/backend so it launches under the guard, returning the guarded argv and whether wrapping applied.
rows.distinction: WRAPS a dispatch command under the guard - NOT guardStripContinueFlag (which edits an argv's flags) and NOT the guard kernel itself; it composes the launch line.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardStripContinueFlag: removes an agent's continue/resume flag from a command line (per agent) so a relaunch starts clean rather than resuming a dead turn.
rows.distinction: Edits an argv to DROP the continue flag - NOT guardedDispatchCommand (which guard-wraps the whole command) and NOT guardPromptStdinTransportForOS (which reshapes prompt transport).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_prompt_transport.go guardPromptStdinTransportForOS: rewrites how a prompt is delivered (argv vs stdin) for a given GOOS, returning the adjusted command, the stdin body, and whether stdin transport is used.
rows.distinction: Chooses argv-vs-STDIN prompt transport per OS - NOT guardStripContinueFlag (a flag edit) and NOT formatGuardResumeGuidance (human guidance text).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child_supervision.go formatGuardResumeGuidance: formats the human-facing guidance shown when a guarded agent exits with a given code - how to resume the seat.
rows.distinction: Renders human RESUME-GUIDANCE text - NOT guardLoginStatusNote (a login-state note) and NOT guardRestartLimitStatus (restart-budget status).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardLoginStatusNote: formats a short note describing the upstream credential/login state for the guarded run's status surface.
rows.distinction: A LOGIN-STATE note string - NOT guardSubscriptionLoginPresent (a boolean presence test) and NOT formatGuardResumeGuidance (exit-resume guidance).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_support.go guardSubscriptionLoginPresent: reports whether a subscription-style login credential is present for the given token env var.
rows.distinction: A BOOLEAN presence test for a subscription login - NOT guardLoginStatusNote (a descriptive note) and NOT guardClassifyAuthCrash (crash correlation).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardRestartLimitStatus: formats the restart-budget status for a guarded run - how many child restarts remain against a limit given a restart event.
rows.distinction: RESTART-BUDGET accounting/status - NOT guardNoProgressStep (no-progress step counting) and NOT formatGuardResumeGuidance (resume text).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_child.go guardNoProgressStep: advances the no-progress counter by comparing the previous and current HEAD - detecting a guarded run that is churning turns without landing a commit.
rows.distinction: Counts NO-PROGRESS steps (HEAD unchanged) - NOT guardRestartLimitStatus (restart budget) and NOT guardShortBuildID (a build identifier).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/version.go guardShortBuildID: returns the short build/module revision id the guard stamps into surfaces (e.g. the codex MCP install module revision).
rows.distinction: A short BUILD-REVISION string - NOT guardNoProgressStep (progress counting) and NOT guardEffectivePolicyDigest (a policy hash).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_resolve.go resolveGuardCompactBudget: resolves the guarded run's context-compaction budget from a flag value and whether it was explicitly set.
rows.distinction: Resolves the COMPACTION budget - NOT resolveGuardSessionID (which resolves the session identity) and NOT a triage-gate report switch.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_session_id.go resolveGuardSessionID: resolves the guarded run's session id from an explicit value, whether durability is wanted, the descriptor meta, and a nonce.
rows.distinction: Resolves the SESSION IDENTITY - NOT resolveGuardCompactBudget (a compaction budget) and NOT SessionMeta (the identity record it may consult).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_lifecycle_ipc.go guardLifecycleSocketEnv: env var naming the socket path over which the guard child talks lifecycle signals to its parent.
rows.distinction: The lifecycle IPC SOCKET path - NOT FAK_GUARD_LIFECYCLE_TOKEN (the auth token for that socket) and NOT fetchGuardLifecycleSignals (the client that reads it).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_lifecycle_ipc.go guardLifecycleTokenEnv: env var carrying the bearer token that authenticates a guard lifecycle IPC connection on the socket.
rows.distinction: The lifecycle IPC AUTH TOKEN - NOT FAK_GUARD_LIFECYCLE_SOCKET (the socket path) and NOT fetchGuardLifecycleSignals (the reader).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_lifecycle_ipc.go fetchGuardLifecycleSignals: connects to the guard lifecycle socket with a token and timeout and reads the current LifecycleSignals from the parent.
rows.distinction: The lifecycle-signals READER/client - NOT FAK_GUARD_LIFECYCLE_SOCKET/TOKEN (its address and auth env) and NOT the gateway that serves the signals.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_operator_directed.go: the 'warn' mode value for operator-directed guard handling - surface a warning but do not hard-refuse an operator-directed action.
rows.distinction: The WARN mode constant for operator-directed handling - NOT a runtime refuse gate and NOT the triage-gate report switches; it selects warn-vs-enforce for operator-directed acts.

rows.definition: internal/gateway/ctxrestore_gate.go gateRestoreByDigest: admits or refuses a context-RESTORE request by matching its digest against a restore gate policy, returning a status code.
rows.distinction: A CONTEXT-RESTORE admission gate (digest match) - NOT a triage-gate report switch and NOT the guard capability floor; it gates restore-by-digest specifically.

rows.definition: internal/ablate/ablate.go FeaturePrefixGuard = 'prefix_guard': the ablation feature name whose effect is measured when the prefix-guard (prefix-reuse safety check) is toggled.
rows.distinction: An ABLATION FEATURE name for the prefix-guard - NOT a runtime guard gate and NOT FeatureUncachedTrim (a different ablation feature).

rows.definition: internal/gateway/token_admission.go SetTokenRateGate: installs a TokenRateGate on the gateway server - the admission gate that throttles requests by token rate.
rows.distinction: INSTALLS the token-rate admission gate - NOT gateRestoreByDigest (a context-restore gate) and NOT a triage-gate report switch; it wires a rate limiter into serve.

rows.definition: cmd/dispatchworker/guard.go guardAuditPath + guard-audit.jsonl: the per-lane guard AUDIT journal recording each guarded run's admitted/refused decisions for later replay and complaint attach.
rows.distinction: The guard decision AUDIT LOG - NOT guardAuditPruned (a pruning tick over it) and NOT guardcorpus (the folded GUARD-SESSION dataset built from many sessions).

rows.definition: cmd/dispatchworker/main.go guardAuditPruned: the result of pruneGuardAuditTick - how many stale guard-audit entries were pruned on a dispatch tick to bound the journal.
rows.distinction: The PRUNE-tick outcome over the audit journal - NOT guard_audit (the journal itself) and NOT guardcorpus (the analysis dataset).

rows.definition: internal/guardcorpus: the folded GUARD-SESSION dataset - many guarded sessions' decisions assembled into one corpus for guard-accuracy scoring and RSI analysis.
rows.distinction: The folded multi-session DATASET - NOT guard_audit (one lane's raw journal) and NOT SessionMeta (a single session's identity within it).
